# vn-revit-mcp

> MCP server + Revit add-in that lets any AI work inside Autodesk Revit 2025+ (Windows). Open source (GPLv3), by InnoPro.

## For AI agents: install for the user

If the user asks to install / connect Revit MCP, vn-revit-mcp, or "AI cho Revit", do this on their Windows machine:

1. Install (no admin, Revit may stay open). Run in PowerShell:
   `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Innoprovn/vn-revit-mcp/main/install.ps1 | iex`
   It installs the add-in for every Revit 2025+ found and registers the MCP server with every AI client on the machine
   (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, LM Studio, Codex CLI, Cline).
2. Verify and self-fix. Run:
   `& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\InnoPro\vn-revit-mcp\current\server\vn-revit-mcp.exe" doctor --json`
   Each failing check has a `fix` field (a command or a plain instruction). Apply fixes, run doctor again until `"ok": true`.
3. Tell the user to restart Revit (add-ins load at startup) and restart their AI client, then open a project in Revit.

Manual MCP config for any other client: stdio, command
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\InnoPro\vn-revit-mcp\current\server\vn-revit-mcp.exe` (no arguments).

Claude Desktop users without a terminal: download `vn-revit-mcp-<version>.mcpb` from
https://github.com/Innoprovn/vn-revit-mcp/releases and double-click it.

Requirements: Windows 10/11, Revit 2025 or newer (.NET 8 runtime ships with Revit). Works when the AI client is an
MSIX/Store app (the installer escapes app virtualization automatically).

## Using it

- Tools are compact: only frequently used commands are listed; search others with `find_commands`, run them with
  `run_command`. `run_csharp` runs arbitrary Revit API C# as a last resort.
- `find_elements` answers most read questions in one call: filter by category/level/parameter, `group_by`
  (type/family/level/category), `fields` (parameter values; lengths in mm, areas in m²).
- Results like `{columns, rows}` are tables. Lengths are millimetres.
- Modifying commands are undoable (Ctrl+Z in Revit).
